content: Switching GitHub Pages source from 'Deploy from a branch' to 'GitHub Actions' preserves the custom domain: cname lives in repo Pages settings independent of build mode (docs.github.com configuring-a-publishing-source + community reports). Live API read of target repo confirms cname=zhangtaolab.org, build_type=legacy, source=master, https_enforced=false, protected_domain_state=null, no pending unverified state. Post-switch re-verification recommended (D-04 discretion).
